sourceModel: Full canonical Anny + GNM; exact existing R02 body presets

method.surface: Every canonical skin-material vertex; exact CPU replay of every CSR influence and joint-conditioned rest position. No top-four truncation or decimation.
method.frames: Neutral + eight existing choreography poses per actor, with actual floor/facing/placement and nonzero translated root group.
method.mask: All canonical Anny body vertices plus GNM recipes whose two source materials are skin. Excludes teeth, gums, tongue, scleras, irises and pupils; no separate hair geometry exists in this canonical topology.
method.distance: Each actual surface vertex is evaluated against exact individual capsule/sphere signed distances. Their minimum is a union implicit field: exact distance outside the union; negative inside. In primitive overlaps its negative magnitude is a clearance lower bound, not exact distance to the union boundary.
method.insideProxyClearance: Maximum depth inside an individual proxy at each skin vertex, a lower bound on union boundary clearance. It is NOT an outward-normal gap, skin SDF, bidirectional Hausdorff distance, or volume metric.
method.boundarySample: Deterministic primitive-boundary samples to nearest triangle on full posed skin BVH. Unsigned distances only; overlap-hidden primitive boundaries are excluded.
method.area: Triangle area divided equally among its three vertices, then accumulated by dominant-influence region. Vertex-lumped estimate, not exact triangle-level miss area.
method.glove: Old-proxy sphere overlap vs exact distance to posed skin triangles at the same frame. Surface intersection only; no closed-volume inside classification.

limitations: Finite pose and primitive-boundary sampling do not certify all continuous animation frames.
No global signed-distance field or watertight-solid inside test is computed.
Dominant-influence body regions are audit labels, not an authored anatomical segmentation.
This audits existing full canonical mesh geometry, not subpixel procedural normal-map displacement.
